info.name: Adobe Experience Cloud Adobe Analytics 2.0 Activities Identities API
Adobe Experience Platform Adobe Experience Cloud List Identity Namespaces

items.docs: Returns a list of all identity namespaces available in the current IMS organization, including standard namespaces (ECID, Email, Phone) and custom namespaces.

info.name: Adobe Experience Platform Adobe Experience Cloud Create an Identity Namespace

items.docs: Creates a custom identity namespace for use in identity resolution and profile unification. The namespace must have a unique code and name.
